questions.question: Write 1 l 500 ml and 1 l 50 ml in millilitres and explain the difference.
questions.expected_answer: 1 l 500 ml is 1 000 ml plus 500 ml, which is 1 500 ml. 1 l 50 ml is 1 000 ml plus 50 ml, which is 1 050 ml. The 50 ml fills only the tens and units places, so the hundreds digit is 0.

questions.question: Explain how to find three quarters of a litre in millilitres.
questions.expected_answer: A litre is 1 000 ml. One quarter is 1 000 divided by 4, which is 250 ml. Three quarters is 3 times 250 ml, which is 750 ml.

questions.question: A 5 l pot of soup is shared into cups of 250 ml. How many cups can be filled? Show how to check.
questions.expected_answer: Each litre fills 4 cups of 250 ml, so 5 l fills 5 times 4, which is 20 cups. Check: 20 times 250 ml is 5 000 ml, which is 5 l.
